name: Plans To Prosper
overview: Scripture reveals that true prosperity is found in trusting the LORD wholeheartedly and acknowledging Him in every aspect of life, as Proverbs instructs that He will direct our paths when we do so. This divine guidance brings not only material blessings but also honor and life through humility and reverence toward God. The believer who dwells securely in God's presence will experience renewal of strength and protection, as depicted in Psalms and Isaiah, assuring that God's plans lead to spiritual and lasting well-being rather than mere earthly gain.
